Yoma 79ᵃ without the husk ח׳ קרי לה Ms. M. a. Ar. (ed. אוּשְׁלָא) it is called ḥushla (not שעורה).

<cite ref="Bava Kamma 30b:20">B. Kam. 30ᵇ</cite> bot. <he>אפקר ח׳</he> ed. (Ms. M. <he>אוּשְׁלֵי</he>, Ms. H. <he>חֲשִׁילֵי</he>) declared as free property peeled barley (which one had spread on public ground for drying).
<cite ref="Moed Katan 16b:13">M. Kat. 16ᵇ</cite> <he>קא מניפה חוּשְׁלָאֵי</he> (omitted in Ms., v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) was winnowing peeled barley.
